implementation.targetScope: ButtonBase, Button, IconButton, Fab, ButtonGroup, ToggleButton and ToggleButtonGroup: native/link/custom roots, keyboard and focus behavior, disabled/loading controls, controlled toggles and VentiMath theme/sx overrides. The remaining Material component families and full theme creation are not implemented.
implementation.remainingWork: Forms and validation controls; typography, surfaces and data display; navigation, menus, tabs and overlays; full Material theme creation and remaining app-used exports; whole-app integration and consumer release.

changes: Written independently over VPM System and its styling closure; no upstream Material runtime, Babel or prop-types ships.
Native button semantics and direct React rendering; no imperative HTML insertion.
Owned refs and ripple timers are released on unmount; theme changes retain control DOM.

caller.scope: Navigation actions, contest forms, family area/reminder toggles, palette selector and navbar Fab. Building this subset does not switch VentiMath dependencies.
